about.title: About Us
about.body1: Kosova Law Firm is an Istanbul-based firm providing legal counsel and litigation services to individual and corporate clients. We serve across a wide range of practice areas, primarily family and inheritance law, employment law, commercial and corporate law, criminal law, real estate law, and enforcement and bankruptcy law.
about.body2: Our working principle is to correctly understand our clients' needs, provide preventative legal support by anticipating disputes as early as possible, and keep clients informed transparently and regularly throughout the process. In addition to litigation and enforcement proceedings, we also guide our clients through alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation.
about.body3: Our team consists of lawyers experienced in different areas of expertise; on every matter, our lawyers specializing in the relevant field work together to provide our clients with comprehensive legal support.
